answers.A_active_graph_replay: YES for all 9 cases; active call counts are recorded per case. Short: 21 Draft replays; long: 47 Draft replays.
answers.B_target_draft_distinguishability: Host labels distinguish Draft and Target ranges; native task/flow correlation to a specific generation is UNRESOLVED without calibrated IDs.
answers.C_replay_update_association: Manager range includes replay+UPDATE; separate UPDATE Host subrange is UNRESOLVED.
answers.D_stream_wait_overlap: stream_id/task_id fields exist in task_time.csv; same/cross-stream overlap is not causally resolved.
answers.E_copy_bytes: acl_memcpy_host_to_device / acl_memcpy_device_to_host events exist; byte counts are UNAVAILABLE (no size field). D2D bytes/time not established.
answers.F_idle_gap_repeat_prepare_sync: Event::synchronize and flow events exist; device idle/gap and repeated preparation are UNRESOLVED; no calibrated host/device join.
answers.G_off_on_difference: Control/normal pairs report diagnostic host submission deltas only; OFF/ON are different execution paths and total duration is not a speedup claim.
answers.H_profiling_life_overhead: PROFILE_LIFE is DIAGNOSTIC_SERIALIZED; Draft_REPLAY_PLUS_UPDATE host mean is about 1062 ms vs ~1.5-2.9 ms normal, showing serialization overhead; not a release comparison.
answers.I_remaining_gaps: No task-operand addresses, physical read-set, UPDATE effective-generation or completion owner fields; these remain OPEN.
